description: This file defines the DVarP class, which implements the DVARP function for calculating the population variance within a database range in a spreadsheet application. It contains method(s) for evaluating the function based on filtered data according to specified criteria.

classes.name: DVarP
classes.description: Class providing the implementation of the DVARP function to calculate the population variance for a filtered database range.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Calculates the population variance for a filtered range of data based on given criteria, handling errors if the specified field is invalid.
